ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 1:9 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity black surface with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at distal tips and sparse white mottling points scattered bilaterally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 80 degrees and a defined depth extending into the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged boundary with pixel amplitudes of 5-12 pixels relative to the mean trailing edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity with a steepening curve leading to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Focal clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixels at the distal-most tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the black pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks across the fluke surface and localized white scarring at the distal tips.
